notes.PRK: UN SNA AMA file 2 (GDP current USD) and file 9 (per capita), 2024. Official UN value 17,199,287,594.87 → 17199287595; per capita 666.732… → 666.7. IMF does not cover the DPRK. Bank of Korea publishes GNI (not used: different exchange-rate basis).
notes.ERI: UN SNA AMA 2024 preferred over World Bank 2011 (2,065,001,626 / 688.7) and last IMF WEO year 2019.
notes.TWN_SDS_YEM: Nominal totals are IMF WEO Oct 2026 NGDPD for 2025, matching the per-capita figures already on the card (TWN 39512, SDS 454, YEM 418). Published full values: TWN 920,585,000,000; SDS 5,539,000,000; YEM 7,860,000,000 (consistent with NGDPDPC × LP in the repo's imf_gdppc.json / imf_lp.json, rounded to millions as in the WEO tables).
notes.skipped: Western Sahara, Antarctica, French Southern Territories: no credible standalone GDP series. Falkland Islands: not in UN SNA AMA or IMF WEO; CIA Factbook was unavailable at patch time. Cuba, Venezuela, Afghanistan, Syria, Liechtenstein, Monaco already have World Bank nominal and per-capita rows (left unchanged). South Korea (KOR) already has World Bank 2025 figures.
